hypotheses.claim: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail strategy across XRP, RLUSD, USDC, JPYSC, OUSD, Arc and traditional payment distribution rather than choosing one exclusive blockchain/stablecoin partner.
support: SBI Circle JV and USD50M Circle equity
SBI Circle Arc founding-validator role and ARC presale participation
SBI/Startale JPYSC and OUSD PoC with SMBC 5% stake
SBI XRP rewards/card and Ripple RLUSD distribution
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: These initiatives sit in different subsidiaries and stages; no single public corporate document states one integrated multi-rail strategy.

hypotheses.claim: Arc's USDC-gas model and StableFX could substitute for XRP as an intermediary in some stablecoin-only cross-border corridors.
support: USDC gas, sub-second finality and 24/7 StableFX
Coinbase and Binance are named Arc exchange access partners
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: JPYSC is not publicly transferable at capture, JPYSC-OUSD is a PoC, Arc validators are permissioned and no Arc corridor volumes or XRP displacement are disclosed.

hypotheses.claim: Native USDC on XRPL can increase XRPL stablecoin liquidity while preserving a role for XRP as a DEX bridge asset.
support: Circle USDC launched natively on XRPL
Ripple says XRPL DEX auto-bridging uses XRP
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: No executed bridge turnover, order-book depth, or incremental XRP demand has been measured; stablecoin pairs can trade directly.

hypotheses.claim: SBI deposit/shareholder rewards and Visa card points may expand retail XRP acquisition and retention in Japan.
support: XRP vouchers offered through deposits and shareholder benefits
Visa card allows XRP as one selectable reward asset
SBI VC Trade reported 2M registered accounts
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: Campaigns have no published redemption/volume data; account registrations are not active users; reward XRP may be sourced from inventory rather than open-market purchases.

hypotheses.claim: Coinbase is broadening stablecoin distribution beyond USDC while retaining material Circle economics.
support: Coinbase added RLUSD to Prime/Exchange/app and supports three networks
Coinbase is an Arc exchange partner and Open Standard founding partner
USDC average balances and Q3 stablecoin revenue remain substantial
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: No RLUSD/OUSD/Arc volume or revenue contribution is disclosed; USDC remains the dominant measured stablecoin revenue source.

hypotheses.claim: Circle's USYC/USDC collateral stack may increase institutional preference for yield-bearing tokenized Treasury collateral over volatile crypto collateral in some derivatives workflows.
support: Circle announced USYC as off-exchange collateral for Binance institutional derivatives
USYC is near-instantly fungible with USDC
hypotheses.counter_hypothesis: No balances, haircuts, utilization, client mix or direct comparison with XRP collateral are disclosed; product availability does not establish actual adoption.
